text:
nina: quick recap: loading a 16-shard safetensors bundle for convo-4B showed lots of tiny reads at embedding/proj layers, causing IO tails.

raj: our prefetch groups by layer; tiny layers produce many small range requests -> backend thrash.

olivia: trace shows parse_header -> many 1-4KB read_blob calls -> memcpy. streaming loader serializes parse+copy.

marcus: short-term: runtime coalesce ranges (with optional artifact hints). long-term: pack small layers into an inline blob region at bundle time.

nina: proposal: optional `warmup_hints` in safetensors metadata: {preferred_order, coalesce_window_bytes, prompt_hot_layers}. loader falls back if absent.

raj: loader plan: index-first if available; else consult hints; coalesce adjacent ranges up to window; issue async range reads and preallocate buffers to minimize memcpy.

olivia: add metrics: small_read_count, coalesce_efficiency, per-tensor ready_latency. add guard to revert if coalescing hurts latency.

infra-bot: scheduled perf job ML-2476 to compare current vs coalesce heuristics vs coalesce+artifact-hints, 3 configs x 10 runs, ETA 48h.

marcus: I'll spec minimal packer doc for inline-blob layout. raj/olivia: can spike loader coalescing (2d).

nina: thanks — tagging for loader-refactor epic.
